content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Associate
content_sections.text: The position is in the laboratory of the Department of Gastroenterology & Human Nutrition at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029; the notice is signed by Dr. Vineet Ahuja, MD, DM, Professor of the department. According to the notice, the laboratory has established patient-derived 3D intestinal organoid (colonoid) models for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including ulcerative colitis (UC). The current project centres on developing autologous organoid co-culture systems incorporating Lamina Propria Mononuclear Cells (LPMCs) and Fibroblasts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice accepts any one of these three options: Four years Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / Master's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / BVSc / B.Pharma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent OR Master's degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent The notice numbers the experience lines (i) to (iii) in the same way as the qualification options: (i) Four years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology organization and Scientific activities and service. (ii) Two years' experience in R&D Industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. (iii) Nil Practical experience in at least two of the areas listed under the job description below (organoid and cell culture, characterization and assessment, molecular and genomic analysis) will be considered an added advantage. The notice gives the age limit as 40. It does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities and technical competencies: Adult stem cell-derived human intestinal organoid culture, maintenance, and optimization Primary cell culture: fibroblast and lamina propria mononuclear cell (LPMC) isolation and characterization Co-culture model development and optimization (organoid + primary cell integration) Flow cytometry (FACS) - cell sorting, gating, population analysis Immunofluorescence and immunocytochemistry (ICC) staining Live-cell imaging and confocal microscopy Functional cell-based assays RT-qPCR and Western blotting/Multiplex protein assay scRNA-seq sample preparation and library prep Transcriptomics data interpretation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Associate
content_sections.text: Interested candidates are requested to send their resume/CV by email to [email protected] by 21 November 2026 . The notice does not mention an application form, an email subject line or an application fee. Resume / CV
